The complete 1968 official-gazette volume, containing among other acts Paul VI's apostolic letter Roma altera of 29 September 1967 constituting St. Robert Bellarmine co-patron of the archdiocese of Capua (pp. 12-13). No exact artifact is registered; consumers using the vatican.va OCR scan record their access route and date locally.
